what: The film's narrator: a voice Fish Audio Drama 3 designed from the description below, with no reference audio, so it copies no real person. Every section of the film is read by Drama 3 in this voice (ref_audio = narrator.wav, ref_text = text).
description: [an airline pilot in his forties, relaxed and friendly, explaining something to a passenger, plain everyday speech]
text: When the NTSB reviewed thirty-seven airline accidents where the crew played a part, it found the same thing in thirty-one of them. Someone didn't monitor, or didn't challenge. Crosscheck is the colleague who always does.
chosen_from: 12 takes, 4 descriptions x 3 seeds; every take was heard word for word by Muse Voice Transcribe. This one: pitch near 100 Hz with moderate movement, 2.5 words a second, pauses between sentences.
